ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a four-membered carbon ring, with a carbon chain extending from the upper right corner of the ring to an N atom; below this N atom there is an N–H bond, and on the right it is connected to another N; a double bond is drawn between the rightmost N and O. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning and counting: Only non-hydrogen-related bonds are counted. There are 4 C–C bonds within the four-membered carbon ring; there is 1 C–C bond from the ring to the substituent carbon; there is 1 C–N bond from this substituent carbon to the first N; there is 1 N–N bond between the two N atoms; the rightmost N=O double bond is counted as one bond, so there is 1. Ignore the N–H bond and all arrows. Therefore the total is 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 8.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure: a four-membered carbon ring, one heavy-atom linker from the ring to an N, then N–N=O, with an N–H bond and curved arrows. Count non-hydrogen bonds region by region: 4 C–C bonds in the ring, 1 C–C bond from the ring to the substituent carbon, 1 C–N bond from that carbon to N, 1 N–N bond, and 1 N=O double bond. Ignore the N–H bond and all arrows. Sum these counted bonds to obtain 8.

推理计数：只计算非氢相关的键。四元碳环内有 4 条 C–C 键；环到取代基碳有 1 条 C–C 键；该取代基碳到第一个 N 有 1 条 C–N 键；两个 N 之间有 1 条 N–N 键；最右侧 N=O 双键按一条键计，有 1 条。忽略 N–H 键和所有箭头。因此总数为 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 8。
